items.statement: The submitted reactant is a validated minimum and each claimed oxidation saddle is a first-order stationary point; the prompt-loss candidate is connected to the defined reactant-side event by IRC or justified equivalent evidence.
items.expected: Frequency classification and event-specific connectivity evidence are reported for individually identified candidates.

items.statement: The activation Gibbs energy for prompt N2 extrusion from 1a is approximately 28.3 kcal/mol under the source calculation convention.
items.expected: A validated prompt-N2-loss barrier is reported near 28.3 kcal/mol, with protocol and uncertainty.

items.statement: The alternative N2-retention oxidation event has a higher activation Gibbs energy, reported as approximately 34.3 kcal/mol.
items.expected: A validated N2-retention barrier is reported near 34.3 kcal/mol and identified as the retained-N2 event.
